lead: A table from data: `columns` and `rows`, with the loading and empty states, an optional checkbox column, sorting, and an actions column whose buttons can ask for confirmation first. It is the table of a list page, ready made; for expandable rows, editable cells or a footer, use `Table` and its parts.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Each column has a `key` and a `title`. A cell shows the row's field of that name as text, or what `render` returns.

action.title: Action
action.key: Identifies the action in the row.
action.label: Text of the button.
action.color: `danger` for a destructive action such as delete.
action.confirm: Asks before it runs: the question, or `{ title, description, confirmLabel, cancelLabel }`. The confirm button is the action's label unless you set `confirmLabel`.
action.onClick: What the action does; when it returns a promise, the confirm button spins until it settles.

selection.title: Selection
selection.description: Give `selected` (the keys of the selected rows) and `onSelectedChange` and the checkbox column appears; the header box selects all or none.

sorting.title: Sorting
sorting.description: A column with `sortable` gets a sort button. It goes ascending, then descending, then none (`null`); sorting the rows, or asking the server to, is yours.

column.title: Column
column.key: Identifies the column (the key of its cells and of the sort); also the field of the row shown when there is no `render`.
column.render: What the cell shows for a row; without it, the row's field named `key` as text.
column.align: Alignment of the header and the cells, a fixed `width` (px), and `fixed` to stick to the start or end edge while the table scrolls sideways.
column.sortable: The header gets a sort button; the sort itself is yours.
column.nowrap: Keep the header and the cells on one line (a date, an id).
column.minWidth: Smallest width (px) the column shrinks to in a narrow table: a title that stays readable instead of wrapping to a few characters per line.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.composed: DataTable is Table + Checkbox + Button + Popconfirm and has no slot of its own: its look comes from the theme styles of those components

sticky.title: Fixed header
sticky.description: `stickyHeader` keeps the header in view and scrolls only the rows. The table takes the height of its parent, which has to have one: a box with a height as here, or a flex column that has one (`Card fill`, `Flex grow`). Without a limit the table is as tall as its rows.

rowclick.title: Row click and current row
rowclick.description: `onRowClick` makes the rows clickable (a click, or Enter / Space on a focused row). A click on a link, a button or the tick box inside the row is theirs, not the row's. `activeKey` highlights the row whose details are open beside the table; it is not the same as the ticked rows.
